zh: 欢迎大家来体验达摩院推出的语音识别模型。
en: Welcome everyone to try the speech recognition model launched by DAMO Academy.

zh: 请稍等，我马上给你答复。
en: Please wait a moment, I will get back to you right away.

zh: 今天的会议改到下午三点。
en: Today's meeting has been moved to three in the afternoon.

zh: 我们需要一份详细的技术方案。
en: We need a detailed technical proposal.

zh: 这个问题我还在核实。
en: I am still verifying this issue.

zh: 感谢你的帮助，非常有用。
en: Thank you for your help, it was very useful.

zh: 请把麦克风关掉再发言。
en: Please mute your microphone before speaking again.

zh: 网络有点卡，你能重复一遍吗？
en: The network is a bit laggy, could you repeat that?

zh: 我们可以先从核心功能开始。
en: We can start with the core features first.

zh: 这个版本已经修复了延迟问题。
en: This version has already fixed the latency issue.

zh: 我听不清，请大声一点。
en: I can't hear clearly, please speak a bit louder.

zh: 翻译结果会实时显示在耳机里。
en: The translation will be shown in the earphones in real time.

zh: 请确认一下你那边的时间。
en: Please confirm the time on your side.

zh: 我们下周再继续讨论这个问题。
en: We will continue discussing this issue next week.

zh: 当前系统只支持中英互译。
en: The current system only supports Chinese-English translation.

zh: 模型已经在本地加载完成。
en: The model has finished loading locally.

zh: 请不要打断对方说话。
en: Please do not interrupt the other person while they are speaking.

zh: 这句话的英文翻译不太自然。
en: The English translation of this sentence is not very natural.

zh: 我们先把延迟压到一秒以内。
en: Let's first get the latency down to under one second.

zh: 你说的意思我大概明白了。
en: I roughly understand what you mean.

zh: 请把文件发到我的邮箱。
en: Please send the file to my email.

zh: 今天天气很好，适合出门。
en: The weather is nice today, good for going out.

zh: 我需要再检查一遍配置。
en: I need to check the configuration again.

zh: 这个功能还在开发中。
en: This feature is still under development.

zh: 请告诉我你的具体需求。
en: Please tell me your specific requirements.

zh: 我们可以通过电话继续沟通。
en: We can continue communicating by phone.

zh: 离线模式不需要连接网络。
en: Offline mode does not require a network connection.

zh: 请稍候，系统正在处理你的请求。
en: Please wait, the system is processing your request.

zh: 我认为这个方案可行。
en: I think this plan is feasible.

zh: 有任何问题随时联系我。
en: Feel free to contact me if you have any questions.

zh: 我们已经完成了第一阶段测试。
en: We have finished the first-stage testing.

zh: 请用更简单的话解释一下。
en: Please explain it in simpler words.

zh: 音频质量会影响识别准确率。
en: Audio quality will affect recognition accuracy.

zh: 我这边信号不太好。
en: The signal on my side is not very good.

zh: 让我们回到刚才的话题。
en: Let's go back to the previous topic.

zh: 这个错误已经在最新版本修复。
en: This bug has been fixed in the latest version.

zh: 请先保存你的工作进度。
en: Please save your progress first.

zh: 我们明天上午十点开会。
en: We will have a meeting at ten tomorrow morning.

zh: 中文前缀也可能需要完整翻译。
en: Chinese prefixes may also need a complete translation.

zh: 实时翻译要兼顾速度和准确。
en: Real-time translation must balance speed and accuracy.
